snippet.title: Ambrosia Sky Act Two Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Soft Rains is announcing the release date for Ambrosia Sky: Act Two. Ambrosia Sky: Act Two will serve as the climactic and final chapter of Dalia’s journey, delivering the complete conclusion to the story, and will be released as a free update to the base game.

Buy Ambrosia Sky Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3580160/Ambrosia_Sky_Act_One/
